title: Mobile data not working abroad
content:
Applies to: mobile_service.
Typical symptoms: my mobile data doesn't work now that I'm travelling abroad; I'm overseas and my phone connects to a network but no internet.
Cause: Data roaming disabled on the handset, wrong network selection, or roaming not enabled on the account.
Resolution steps:
1. Turn on data roaming in the phone's mobile network settings.
2. Check roaming is enabled on the account and the roaming pass is active.
3. Manually select a partner network in network settings.
4. Confirm the APN settings are correct.
If these steps do not resolve the issue, escalate to second-line support with the results of each step.

title: Unexpected roaming charges
content:
Applies to: mobile_service, billing_system.
Typical symptoms: I got a huge roaming bill after my holiday; my bill has hundreds in roaming charges from my trip.
Cause: Usage outside included roaming zones or without an active roaming pass; spend caps not set.
Resolution steps:
1. Review the itemised roaming usage by country and date.
2. Check whether a roaming pass was active and which zone the country is in.
3. Apply the roaming spend cap rules and credit charges above the cap.
4. Set a roaming spending limit and alerts for future trips.
If these steps do not resolve the issue, escalate to second-line support with the results of each step.

title: Calls failing while roaming
content:
Applies to: mobile_service.
Typical symptoms: I can't make or receive calls while abroad; my calls fail when roaming in the US.
Cause: VoLTE roaming not supported for the handset/network or incorrect dialling format.
Resolution steps:
1. Dial numbers in international format with the + country code.
2. Switch the phone's network mode to allow 3G/4G or select another partner network.
3. Check VoLTE roaming support for the handset on the visited network.
4. Enable Wi-Fi Calling as a workaround.
If these steps do not resolve the issue, escalate to second-line support with the results of each step.
